subject: Pilot extension & phased packaging (Helio Systems)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ariane Dupont <ariane@heliosystems.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-22T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot extension & phased packaging (Helio Systems)

Hi Ariane —

Thanks again for running the pilot with us. The engineering team and I reviewed the telemetry you shared (latency patterns look great for the 2k tokens window) and we think there are two practical ways to keep momentum while protecting both sides:

1) Short extension (4 weeks): focused burst to complete the NLU integration + 16 hours of engineering support; small conversion credit if you convert to Redwood Dedicated within 60 days.
2) Multiphasic extension (6 weeks): lower unit pricing on committed usage tiers, milestone credits tied to two deliverables (intent recall tuning + production throughput test).

Attached is a first-pass multiphasic offer so you can see numbers and milestone gates. If you prefer, we can draft a compact 4-week amendment with the engineering hours baked in.

Proposed next steps: pick option A (4w + eng hrs) or B (6w multiphase) by end of next week, and I’ll loop in legal for an addendum.

Attachment: multiphasic-offer-v1.pdf (proposal, 98KB)

Best,
Jordan

From: Ariane Dupont <ariane@heliosystems.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Luc Moreau <luc@heliosystems.com>
Date: 2027-03-23T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension & phased packaging (Helio Systems)

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear options and the deck. Luc and I discussed; our preference is to keep this tight. A 4-week extension would be ideal from our roadmap perspective, but we need a better rate to justify another procurement pass. A few asks: 

- Target net discount: 25% off the standard eval rates across the committed burst.
- Include 16 engineering hours (remote) to help finalize integration with our privacy router.
- Confirmation that the extension can run on a private VPC node (we can pay a slight premium).

Also attaching our implementation notes so you can see the privacy/data handling constraints. If you can get closer to 25% and confirm the VPC option, I can fast-track an LOI signature.

Attachment: requirements_outline.docx (implementation notes)

Ariane
Ariane Dupont | Head of AI Engineering
Helio Systems
ariane@heliosystems.com | +33 1 82 55 10 22

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-24T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension & phased packaging (Helio Systems)

Ariane — appreciate the clarity. Kim/Dev — looping you in for one quick ask: can we approve a limited commercial concession (25% ask) paired with the VPC option? My proposal to internal is:

- Offer: 4-week extension, 20% discount off eval rates, 16 eng hours, VPC option with a modest infra surcharge (pass-through).
- Trade: Helio signs an LOI committing to a 60-day review to convert to Redwood Dedicated or provide feedback for formal RFP.

If legal needs to review data-handling text for the VPC, Dev can advise on contract language. Ariane, if we can get to 20% + the VPC and the LOI commitment, will that move you to sign quickly?

Jordan

Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ariane Dupont <ariane@heliosystems.com>
Date: 2027-03-25T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension & phased packaging (Helio Systems)

Jordan / Ariane —

Okay to make a controlled concession here to keep the pilot momentum. Approved commercial terms (conditions below):

- Term: 4-week extension (start date to be agreed in LOI).
- Discount: 20% off Redwood eval rates for tokens consumed during the extension period.
- Engineering: 16 hours of dedicated support (remote) to be scheduled within the 4 weeks.
- VPC: We can provision a private VPC node; customer will cover any cloud infra surcharge. No changes to our standard data retention policy; we will include a data-handling annex.
- Conversion right: Helio can elect to convert remaining prepaid credits to the first month invoice if they convert to Dedicated within 60 days of extension end.

Conditions: this concession requires a signed LOI that documents the extension dates and the conversion review window; no SLA escalation or additional credits beyond the 16 eng hours.

I’ve attached a short term sheet you can use to generate the LOI. Jordan — please prepare a one-page LOI and the DocuSign envelope; Dev please confirm the minimal data-handling language for the annex.

Attachment: approved_term_sheet.pdf (term sheet, 12KB)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Ariane Dupont <ariane@heliosystems.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Luc Moreau <luc@heliosystems.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-25T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension & phased packaging (Helio Systems)

Kimberly / Jordan —

Thanks — that core package works for us. I’ll have our procurement review the LOI; two small asks before signature:

1) Please send the DocuSign link for the LOI so we can route it to our legal.
2) Confirm one sentence for the data annex: "Redwood will not persist raw customer inputs beyond 30 days and will only store KV caches necessary for inference; logs stored for <90 days access for debugging under customer request."

If you can confirm those and send the LOI, procurement will route a signed PO within 48 hours.

We’ll also upload a small PO after signature to help finance.

Attachment: helios-docusign-request.url (link placeholder)

Best,
Ariane
